set -eu
cd /srv/legacy2/sparse-image-copy
umask 022
cat > bin/copy-image <<'COPY_IMAGE_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s SOURCE DESTINATION\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

# GNU cp on this legacy host can detect zero runs and create holes explicitly.
# It also truncates an existing destination, so repeated copies cannot retain
# stale data from an earlier, longer image.
exec cp --sparse=always -- "$1" "$2"
COPY_IMAGE_EOF
chmod 0755 bin/copy-image
sed -n '1,120p' bin/copy-image
sh -n bin/copy-image
